title: Polyoxometalate-based all-inorganic open frameworks
claim: An anionic lanthanide–silicotungstate open framework preferentially takes up cationic dyes and, between two cationic dyes, takes up the smaller methylene blue more than rhodamine B.
explanation: W15-La contains a four-shell {La@W8@La8@(SiW12)6} SBU about 2.5 nm on a side. After 600 min in a mixed rhodamine B/methylene blue solution, the crystals captured about 44% of rhodamine B and 84% of methylene blue. In a methylene blue/methyl orange mixture, cationic methylene blue was removed while anionic methyl orange remained, as followed by UV–Vis and the solution color change.
scope: Isostructural frameworks W15-Ln (Ln = La, Pr, Nd), with dye uptake reported for W15-La.
conditions: Immersion of crystals for 600 min in mixed aqueous dye solutions of RhB with MB, or MB with MO.
caveats: Selectivity is demonstrated for these dye pairs on W15-La. The review does not report isotherms, capacities for other guests, or whether Pr and Nd analogues behave identically.
